```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = params$project_root)
setwd(params$project_root)
source("R/bootstrap.R")
library(shiny)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# rmarkdown removes params after knitting; keep paths for later UI callbacks.
snapshot_file <- params$snapshot_file
project_root <- params$project_root
initial_snapshot <- read_dashboard_snapshot(snapshot_file)
pack <- reactiveVal(initial_snapshot)
loaded_from <- reactiveVal(normalizePath(snapshot_file))
load_error <- reactiveVal("")
# No checked states means no data, never an implicit ALL.
state <- reactive({ input$state %||% character() })
assessments_enabled <- reactive({ length(pack()$config$assessments) > 0L })
erdera_profile <- reactive({ identical(pack()$config$profile, "erdera") })
saved_reports <- reactiveVal(setNames(character(), character()))

load_saved_report <- function(path, label) {
  candidate <- tryCatch({
    value <- read_dashboard_snapshot(path)
    # Check the evidence needed by the UI before replacing the working report.
    for (number in 1:5) shared_summary(value, number)
    value
  }, error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(candidate, "error")) {
    load_error(paste("Could not open this report:", conditionMessage(candidate)))
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }
  load_error("")
  pack(candidate)
  loaded_from(label)
  states <- shared_states(candidate)
  updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "state", choices = states, selected = states)
  updateSelectInput(session, "evidence_key", choices = names(shared_evidence(candidate)), selected = "Index")
  removeModal()
  invisible(TRUE)
}
observeEvent(input$reload, {
  load_error("")
  saved_reports(dashboard_saved_reports(snapshot_file, initial_snapshot$config, project_root))
  showModal(modalDialog(
    title = "Load saved results",
    selectInput("saved_report", "Saved reports", choices = c("Choose a saved run..." = "", saved_reports()), width = "100%"),
    actionButton("open_saved_report", "Open selected report"),
    tags$hr(),
    fileInput("report_upload", "Or choose a report from another folder",
      buttonLabel = "Browse...", placeholder = "Select report.rds", accept = ".rds", multiple = FALSE, width = "100%"),
    helpText("Choose report.rds inside a saved run folder. Loading a report does not run a crawl."),
    div(role = "alert", style = "color: #a32626;", textOutput("load_error")),
    easyClose = TRUE, footer = modalButton("Cancel"), size = "l"
  ))
}, ignoreInit = TRUE)
output$load_error <- renderText(load_error())
observeEvent(input$open_saved_report, {
  path <- input$saved_report
  if (length(path) != 1L || !path %in% unname(saved_reports())) {
    load_error("Choose a saved report or use Browse to upload one.")
  } else load_saved_report(path, path)
}, ignoreInit = TRUE)
observeEvent(input$report_upload, {
  upload <- input$report_upload
  req(nrow(upload) == 1L)
  load_saved_report(upload$datapath[[1]], paste("Uploaded:", upload$name[[1]]))
}, ignoreInit = TRUE)
dt <- function(frame, truncate = TRUE) {
  preview <- report_frame(frame)
  for (column in names(preview)) if (is.character(preview[[column]])) {
    long <- truncate & !is.na(preview[[column]]) & nchar(preview[[column]]) > 500L
    preview[[column]][long] <- paste0(substr(preview[[column]][long], 1L, 500L), " ... [download for full text]")
  }
  DT::datatable(preview, rownames = FALSE, escape = TRUE, filter = "none",
    options = list(pageLength = 10, lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
      scrollX = TRUE, autoWidth = TRUE, order = list(),
      columnDefs = list(list(targets = "_all", render = DT::JS(
        "function(data, type) { return data === null && type === 'display' ? 'NA' : data; }")))),
    class = "stripe hover compact")
}
```

# User manual

Select **Index States** to filter all results and downloads. Unchecking every
state shows no data. **Load saved results** lets you open another saved run or
browse your computer for a `report.rds` file. Loading a report selects all its
Index States and updates the tables, charts, test logs and downloads without a new crawl.

<details>
<summary>Quick guide to counts and states</summary>

**Overview**

States are supplied by the FDP index **for each index entry**; the dashboard does
not calculate ACTIVE/INACTIVE status from its own requests. Missing states become
UNKNOWN. An ACTIVE entry can therefore have a failed crawl.

| Metric | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Distinct FDPs in selected states** | Unique valid FDP URLs across the selection. Surrounding whitespace and trailing slashes are removed before deduplication. |
| **Selected index entries** | All selected index rows, including duplicate FDP URLs and invalid/missing URLs. |
| **Entries with invalid/missing URLs** | Selected rows without a valid HTTP(S) FDP URL. |
| **Each state's FDP count** | Unique valid FDP URLs within that state. The smaller **index entries** number counts its rows. |
| **FDPs with recorded structural warnings** | FDPs with at least one counted structural warning. |

State **entry counts** sum to Selected index entries. State **FDP counts** may
overlap because one FDP URL can occur in several states. Use **Distinct FDPs** for
the overall FDP total.

**Reading counts:** state-prefixed columns belong to that state. `NA` means
unavailable, unassessed or inapplicable—not zero. All results describe the saved
crawl; incomplete traversal can hide resources and warnings.

</details>

# Overview

The Overview summarizes the total number of FDPs in the Index, their statuses, alongside the number and type of all structural problems that were recorded.

Selected index entries − Distinct FDPs
  = invalid/missing-URL entries
    + repeated occurrences of valid FDP URLs beyond their first occurrence

```{r overview}
div(class = "report-controls",
  fluidRow(
    column(5, checkboxGroupInput("state", "Index States",
      choices = shared_states(initial_snapshot), selected = shared_states(initial_snapshot), inline = TRUE),
      helpText("Check one or more states. Tables update automatically. Uncheck all to show no data.")),
    column(3, actionButton("reload", "Load saved results")),
    column(4, downloadButton("workbook", "Download selected summary workbook"))
  )
)
output$overview <- renderUI({
  value <- pack()
  card <- function(count, label) div(class = "report-card", strong(count), span(label))
  counts <- dashboard_overview(value, state())
  state_cards <- lapply(names(counts$states), function(st) {
    div(class = "report-card", strong(counts$states[[st]]), span(paste(st, "FDPs")),
      tags$small(paste(counts$state_entries[[st]], "index entries")))
  })
  tagList(
    p(strong(paste("Profile:", value$config$profile)), " | ", value$config$index_url),
    p(paste("Snapshot saved:", value$saved_at)),
    p(paste("Loaded report:", loaded_from())),
    div(class = "report-cards",
      card(counts$fdps, "Distinct FDPs in selected states"),
      card(counts$entries, "Selected index entries"),
      card(counts$invalid_urls, "Entries with invalid/missing URLs"),
      state_cards,
      card(counts$warnings,
        "FDPs with recorded structural warnings")),
    p("All tables, charts, statistics, evidence, test logs and downloads follow the selected Index States. FDP counts include unsuccessful fetches. State columns retain the original separate counts; shared URLs may occur in more than one state."),
    if (assessments_enabled()) div(class = "report-note",
      "This report includes the configured FAIR Champion assessments, test logs and failure reasons. Each test runs independently.")
  )
})
uiOutput("overview")
output$workbook <- downloadHandler(filename = function() paste0("fdpcrawler_", pack()$config$profile, ".xlsx"),
  content = function(file) writexl::write_xlsx(shared_workbook(pack(), state()), file))
```


# Metadata processing

## Table 1 — Fetch and parse outcomes

Shows distinct metadata URLs per layer and state.

- **Metadata Layer:** FDP, Catalog, Dataset, Biobank, Distribution, etc.
- **Fetch successful:** metadata retrieved and successfully parsed as Turtle.
- **Fetch failed:** retrieval or parsing failed; older snapshots also include
  requests skipped because of a document limit.

```{r table1}
output$table1 <- DT::renderDT({ dt(shared_summary(pack(), 1L, state())) })
DT::DTOutput("table1")
```

The metadata chart summarizes successful processing.

```{r metadata-chart}
renderPlot({
  value <- pack()
  states <- shared_states(value, state())
  tables <- setNames(lapply(states, function(st) dashboard_display_summary_one(value, 1L, st)), states)
  validate(need(length(tables) > 0L && any(vapply(tables, nrow, integer(1)) > 0L),
    "No crawled metadata for this selection."))
  layers <- unique(unlist(lapply(tables, function(x) x$`Metadata Layer`)))
  print(plot_table1(groups = tables, layers = layers) + ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9)
  ) + ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)))
}, height = 650, res = 110)
```

# Traversal and structure

## Table 2 — Terminal metadata paths

Shows distinct complete URL paths through the metadata hierarchy.

- **Path:** the sequence of layers, such as FDP–Catalog–Dataset–Distribution.
- **N of times found**, or each state column: number of complete paths of that form.

Counts represent paths, not FDPs. Failed or untraversed paths are excluded.

```{r table2}
output$table2 <- DT::renderDT({ dt(shared_summary(pack(), 2L, state())) })
DT::DTOutput("table2")
```

## Table 3 — Outgoing metadata structure

Shows recorded problem occurrences per **Metadata Layer** and state.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **LDP-only links** | Parent–child links present in an LDP container but missing the corresponding explicit metadata link. |
| **Empty LDP containers** | Parent–container pairs with no recorded contents. |
| **No DCAT or LDP continuation** | Parent documents without a supported outgoing continuation. |
| **Next-step fetch failed** | Linked child metadata could not be successfully processed. |

Categories can overlap; do not sum them as independent problems. `NA` means the
indicator was not applicable or assessed for that layer.

```{r table3}
output$table3 <- DT::renderDT({ dt(shared_summary(pack(), 3L, state())) })
DT::DTOutput("table3")
```

## FDP coverage — Sankey diagram

Shows discovered metadata paths, including incomplete branches. Hover over the
diagram to inspect counts and associated URLs.

```{r sankey}
chart <- reactive({ shared_sankey(pack(), state()) })
# Size for the full snapshot, so filtering never remounts or resizes the widget.
sankey_height <- reactive({ attr(shared_sankey(pack()), "sankey_height") })
div(style = "max-height: 1100px; overflow-y: auto;", uiOutput("sankey_ui"))
output$sankey_ui <- renderUI({ plotly::plotlyOutput("sankey", height = paste0(sankey_height(), "px")) })
output$sankey <- plotly::renderPlotly({
  value <- chart()
  value$height <- sankey_height()
  value$x$layout$height <- value$height
  # A zero-duration transition lets Plotly.react update the existing plot.
  plotly::layout(value, transition = list(duration = 0))
})
```

# Per-FDP results

```{r table4-heading}
output$table4_heading <- renderUI({
  h2(HTML(if (erdera_profile()) "Table 4 &mdash; ERDERA outcomes and structural problems" else
    if (assessments_enabled()) "Table 4 &mdash; Assessment outcomes and structural problems" else
    "Table 4 &mdash; Crawl results and structural problems"))
})
uiOutput("table4_heading")
```

Shows saved assessment outcomes and structural warnings for each FDP.

- **FDP:** the FDP URL.
- **L1/L2 outcome**, when configured: saved assessment result; a request error is
  not a compliance failure.
- **Warning type:** structural warning categories or root-fetch/assessment status.
- **Number of FDPCrawleR warnings:** distinct counted structural occurrences
  across the FDP and its descendants—not the number of warning categories.

```{r table4}
output$table4 <- DT::renderDT({ dt(shared_summary(pack(), 4L, state())) })
DT::DTOutput("table4")
downloadButton("table4_csv", "Download Table 4 for selected states")
output$table4_csv <- downloadHandler(filename = function() "table4.csv", content = function(file) {
  write.csv(shared_summary(pack(), 4L, state()), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
})
```

```{r assessments}
# These outputs exist for every session, even if its initial report has no tests.
# The section and selectors are rebuilt only when a different report is loaded.
output$assessment_section <- renderUI({
  if (!assessments_enabled()) return(NULL)
  labels <- shared_test_labels(pack())
  tagList(
    h2(if (erdera_profile()) "ERDERA test logs" else "FAIR Champion test logs"),
    p("Select an FDP and test to inspect the full log, HTTP status and request error."),
    fluidRow(
      column(9, selectInput("test_fdp", "FDP", choices = names(pack()$assessments))),
      column(3, selectInput("test_level", "Test", choices = setNames(names(labels), labels)))
    ),
    verbatimTextOutput("test_log"),
    h2(HTML(if (erdera_profile()) "Table 5 &mdash; ERDERA failure reasons per FDP" else
      "Table 5 &mdash; Assessment failure reasons per FDP")),
    p("Each row represents one FDP, with separate reasons for each configured test from the saved test logs."),
    p("Includes passes, request errors, and missing results. Use Test logs for the full assessment output."),
    div(id = "failure-reasons", DT::DTOutput("reasons")),
    downloadButton("table5_csv", "Download Table 5 for selected states")
  )
})
uiOutput("assessment_section")
observe({
  choices <- intersect(shared_urls(pack(), state()), names(pack()$assessments))
  selected <- isolate(input$test_fdp)
  if (!length(selected) || !selected %in% choices) selected <- if (length(choices)) choices[[1]] else character()
  updateSelectInput(session, "test_fdp", choices = choices, selected = selected)
})
output$test_log <- renderText({
  if (!assessments_enabled() || !length(input$test_fdp) ||
      !input$test_fdp %in% shared_urls(pack(), state()) || !length(input$test_level) ||
      !input$test_level %in% names(shared_test_labels(pack())))
    return("No assessment recorded for the selected states.")
  row <- pack()$assessments[[input$test_fdp]][[input$test_level]]
  if (is.null(row) || !nrow(row)) return("No assessment recorded.")
  paste(paste("Outcome:", row$outcome), paste("HTTP status:", row$http_status),
    paste("Assessed:", row$tested_at),
    if (!is.na(row$error[[1]]) && nzchar(row$error[[1]])) paste("Request error:", row$error) else NULL,
    report_test_reason(row[1, ]), row$log, sep = "\n\n")
})
output$reasons <- DT::renderDT({
  req(assessments_enabled())
  dt(shared_table5(pack(), state()), truncate = FALSE)
})
output$table5_csv <- downloadHandler(filename = function() "table5.csv", content = function(file) {
  req(assessments_enabled())
  write.csv(shared_table5(pack(), state()), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
})
```

# Evidence explorer

Choose an evidence table to inspect underlying records. Common columns identify
the owner FDP, parent/child URLs, relationship, HTTP status, processing status and
error. In `additional_relationships`, **not traversed** means that relationship
was outside the configured traversal rules. The evidence selector is also
constrained by the global Index State filter.

```{r evidence}
evidence <- reactive({ shared_evidence(pack(), state()) })
selectInput("evidence_key", "Evidence table", choices = names(shared_evidence(initial_snapshot)))
output$evidence_table <- DT::renderDT({
  req(input$evidence_key)
  frame <- evidence()[[input$evidence_key]]
  validate(need(!is.null(frame), "No evidence table available."))
  dt(frame)
})
DT::DTOutput("evidence_table")
downloadButton("evidence_csv", "Download full evidence table")
output$evidence_csv <- downloadHandler(filename = function() paste0(input$evidence_key, ".csv"), content = function(file) {
  write.csv(evidence()[[input$evidence_key]], file, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
})
```
